title: Zotero Reference Management for Research Pipelines
description: A ScholarSkills package (SS-0001) that operates a Zotero library through the Web API v3: counting references correctly (attachments excluded, totals from headers), paginating a collection to completion, exporting BibTeX/RIS/CSL JSON, and writing items when the key's scope allows it. The API key is treated as the boundary of access: the skill reports a missing scope instead of working around it.
